title: Right adjoint of a proper flat derived pushforward commutes with direct sums
statement: Let Y be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], let f:X\to Y be proper, flat, and of finite presentation [def-weil-proper-morphism, def-weil-flat-morphism], and let a be the right adjoint to Rf_* on quasi-coherent derived categories [def-pc-derived-category, def-pc-derived-direct-image]. Then a commutes with all set-indexed direct sums in D_QCoh(Y).

proof.text: Properness over qcqs Y supplies CompactSpace X and QuasiSeparatedSpace X by Mathlib. Choose derived-category localization structures on opens using nonempty_derivedOpenLocalization (these structures are unique up to the localization equivalences used downstream). Perfect direct image in the independently supplied models is properFlat_derivedDirectImage_perfect. Transport it along hF.app P, and apply perfectObjectCompact on X and Y to every perfect P and its F-image.

Choose the existing small family G of representatives of perfect objects, each compact and with compact F-image. The private compact_tests_small calculation identifies the Hom map of sigmaComparison a K using adj.homAddEquiv, the DirectSum maps, and the two compactness bijections. Naturality on each coprojection proves the commuting square, and bijectivity of the other maps proves bijectivity of Hom(G s, sigmaComparison a K).

The supported perfect generator with total support supplies the inherited triangulated structure. Perfect generation and the representative family imply weak generation via schemeDerivedQCoh_representatives_generate. The private perfect_test_detection transfers the Hom bijections to all perfect objects by representative isomorphisms. Shifts preserve perfection by explicit reindexing of the local strictly perfect complexes. Complete a tested morphism g to a distinguished triangle. Shift adjunction, exactness of Hom, and the assumed bijections show every map from a shifted perfect object to its cone is zero. Weak generation forces the cone to be zero, so g is an isomorphism. Apply this to sigmaComparison a K, and PreservesCoproduct.of_iso_comparison followed by preservesColimitsOfShape_of_discrete proves preservation for each I:Type u, including I empty.
